name: Custer Virginia Marketplace
summary: Custer Virginia Marketplace is a community shopping center strategically located along North Custer Road in McKinney's thriving northern corridor. Managed by Weitzman Group, this open-air center serves the surrounding residential communities with convenient access to retail and services.
demographics: Custer Virginia Marketplace serves the affluent northern McKinney area, attracting primarily middle to upper-middle income families with household incomes exceeding $100,000. The trade area draws young professionals and established families, typically aged 30-55, who value convenience and quality in their shopping experience. The center's location along North Custer Road positions it within one of McKinney's fastest-growing corridors, serving both local residents and commuters seeking accessible retail and dining options.
description: Custer Virginia Marketplace is a well-positioned community shopping center located in the thriving northern McKinney area at 210 North Custer Road. Developed and managed by Weitzman Group, a respected Texas-based commercial real estate firm known for creating successful retail destinations throughout the region, this center serves as a convenient retail hub for the surrounding residential communities. The marketplace benefits from its strategic location along the heavily-trafficked Custer Road corridor, one of McKinney's primary commercial arteries that connects growing neighborhoods to essential services and shopping. With its open-air design and accessible layout, the center provides a comfortable shopping environment that caters to the daily needs of local families and professionals. The property maintains strong visibility and easy access, making it a go-to destination for residents seeking quality retail and service options in north McKinney's expanding market.
